ENGLISH ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #16
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: ENGLISH ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Spelling, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Spelling.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Spelling.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Spelling.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Spelling.

2. The past tense of “go” is: (1 mark)
   A. goed
   B. goes
   C. going
   D. went

3. When practising Punctuation, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Punctuation.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Punctuation.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Punctuation.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Punctuation.

4. When practising Attentive Listening, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Attentive Listening.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Attentive Listening.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Attentive Listening.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Attentive Listening.

5. A noun is a word that names: (1 mark)
   A. Only a describing word
   B. A person, place, thing, or idea
   C. Only a joining word
   D. Only an action

6. When practising Language Activities at home, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Language Activities at home.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Language Activities at home.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Language Activities at home.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Language Activities at home.

7. When practising Handwriting, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Handwriting.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Handwriting.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Handwriting.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Handwriting.

8. Choose the correctly punctuated sentence. (1 mark)
   A. Where is the library
   B. where is the library
   C. Where is the library?
   D. Where is the Library

9. When practising Word Reading, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Word Reading.
   B. Copy random text without understanding Word Reading.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Word Reading.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Word Reading.

10. Which word is a verb? (1 mark)
   A. blue
   B. quickly
   C. run
   D. happiness

11. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. No full stops
   B. Many unrelated topics with no link
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences

12. When practising Connected text and fluency, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Connected text and fluency.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Connected text and fluency.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Connected text and fluency.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Connected text and fluency.

13. When practising Guided Writing, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Guided Writing.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Guided Writing.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Guided Writing.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Guided Writing.

14. When practising Comprehension, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Comprehension.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Comprehension.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Comprehension.
   D. Avoid reading anything related to Comprehension.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
15. In three clear sentences, explain Comprehension and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Handwriting and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Spelling and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Punctuation and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Guided Writing and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

20. In three clear sentences, explain Attentive Listening and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
